IntroHistory.ReferredTo: Referred to Committee on Local Government.

Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing counties to increase funding for properties acquired through conservation futures.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to operation and maintenance of open space,agricultural, and timber lands acquired through the conservationfutures program; and amending RCW 84.34.230 and 84.34.240.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 84.34.230 and 1995 c 318 s 8 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For the purposes of acquiring conservation futures as well as otherrights and interests in real property pursuant to RCW 84.34.210 and84.34.220, and for maintaining and operating any property acquired, acounty may levy an amount not to exceed ((six and onequarter)) elevencents per thousand dollars of assessed valuation against the assessedvaluation of all taxable property within the county. The limitationsin RCW 84.52.043 shall not apply to the tax levy authorized in thissection.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 84.34.240 and 1971 ex.s. c 243 s 5 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any board of county commissioners may establish by resolution aspecial fund which may be termed a conservation futures fund to which p. 1 HB 1140it may credit all taxes levied pursuant to RCW 84.34.230. Amountsplaced in this fund may be used ((solely)) for the purpose of acquiringrights and interests in real property pursuant to the terms of RCW84.34.210 and 84.34.220, and for the maintenance and operation of anyproperty acquired. The amount of revenue used for maintenance andoperations of parks and recreational facilities may not exceed twentyfive percent of the total amount collected from the tax levied underRCW 84.34.230 in the preceding calendar year. Revenues from this taxmay not be used to supplant existing maintenance and operation funding.Nothing in this section shall be construed as limiting in any mannermethods and funds otherwise available to a county for financing theacquisition of such rights and interests in real property.
